host_boundary: Complete original Line color getter/setter and real complete color validation/RGBA helpers, entire original fixed named map including aliases. Existing actual Line unit/data host. Rc/CycleData are declared stored rc/cycler by_key capabilities, not full Cycler or RcParams assignment validation; no Axes color iterator is supplied or consumed. RGBA is an independent primitive, not Line.draw or full SVG. Non-string mutable RGB list is source-only.

typed_boundaries.legacy_records: All original 49 preparation records are retained in full. First 47 String/live-rc records project onto typed raw String/state plus the private RGBA helper; last two mutable RGB alias records are source-only.
typed_boundaries.new_strings: Four independent original String records cover multi-character Kelvin lowercase, single-character Kelvin rejection and leading-zero C index digit limit on each side.
typed_boundaries.unicode: All 1163 actual names are ASCII. Root independently checked CPython Unicode15 lowercase: Kelvin U+212A is the only non-ASCII codepoint whose lowercase becomes all ASCII. This is profile rationale, not an added Matplotlib observation.
typed_boundaries.named: The generated production exact lookup and 1163 primitive expected RGBA bit vectors both come from the complete original map and real to_rgba, without port lookup as an oracle.
typed_boundaries.style: Native raw names/RGBA are distinct from existing Rgba.to_css convenience serialization; no native SVG CSS or viewer parity is claimed.
typed_boundaries.cache: Native module color-cache sizes, String object identity, Rc/Cycler read traces and mutable private map are evidence without new public cache/identity/callback protocols.
typed_boundaries.draw: Three independent complete original draw observations use solid/no-marker control. Typed projection invokes production Panel.prepare_line and success completion, without fixture empty/visibility/color branching.
typed_boundaries.initialization: Explicit black/width2 initial Line is the existing typed plot bridge. Private mark_drawn supplies only the recorded clean-stale inputs; it is not a native draw claim.
